page_title: WOL 2-1 FUL | Wolves v Fulham 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' The attendance for today's match is 30860.
90+9' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Tony Harrington to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Fulham players can finally celebrate.
90+9' Wait! Referee Tony Harrington has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+8' 2 - 1 Goal! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:1.

90+6' Bernd Leno doesn't have to worry about this one. Rayan Ait-Nouri plays a pass into the feet of Mario Lemina (Wolves), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
90+5' Willian (Fulham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+4' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Joao Palhinha (Fulham) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
90+3' Joao Gomes finds Thomas Doyle (Wolves) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.

90+1' The cross into the penalty area from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Jose Sa (Wolves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
86' Jose Sa (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
85' Adama Traore (Fulham) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
85' The resulting corner from Willian (Fulham) comes to nothing.
82' Adama Traore (Fulham) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jose Sa sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.

80' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the top right corner, but Jose Sa reacts superbly to deny him. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is first to the rebound and sends a header goalwards but it's blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Armando Broja (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Timothy Castagne.
79' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
78' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
78' Referee Tony Harrington sees the trip by Joao Palhinha (Fulham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Wolves are awarded the free kick.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Matt Doherty (Wolves) is replacing Nathan Fraser.
76' 5:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.
72' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
70' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Harry Wilson and he is replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
69' That will be all from Sasa Lukic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joao Palhinha (Fulham).
69' No offside! Referee Tony Harrington points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Wolves players celebrate.
69' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Wolves players aren’t happy.
67' 2 - 0 Tom Cairney (Fulham) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
64' A pass from Mario Lemina (Wolves) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.
63' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Willian (Fulham).
61' That's the end of the game for Harrison Reed, who is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
60' Max Kilman (Wolves) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
60' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

59' Bernd Leno was forced into action to thwart Nathan Fraser (Wolves). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
57' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
56' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
52' 1 - 0 Goal! Toti provides Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 1:0.
51' Harrison Reed (Fulham) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
49' What a chance that is! Harry Wilson (Fulham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
48' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) forces a pass into the box, but Bernd Leno is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
46' Tony Harrington blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Gary O'Neil is forced to make a change. Pedro Neto is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Toti (Wolves).
45+1' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
44' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Pedro Neto (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
41' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Wolves was in an offside position.
40' Harrison Reed (Fulham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tony Harrington blows his whistle for an infringement. Wolves have a free kick.
35' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) blows a good opportunity to score. Without hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the crossbar!
35' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andreas Pereira (Fulham).

34' So close! Harry Wilson (Fulham) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tony Harrington signals. Fulham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
31' The total number of attempts is 1:4. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
28' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) and Mario Lemina attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
26' One of the players from Wolves times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
25' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Jose Sa.
25' Alex Iwobi picks out Harry Wilson (Fulham), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
24' Good defending. Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to find Harry Wilson inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
22' Pedro Neto (Wolves) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
22' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolves.
22' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
20' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the left post.
19' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts to release Rodrigo Muniz with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
16' Pedro Neto (Wolves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
12' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves).
11' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Thomas Doyle.
11' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but Jose Sa makes a decent save to stop the effort.
11' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
7' The game is interrupted now, Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Jose Sa makes a great save to stop his effort. Corner kick. Fulham will have an opportunity.
4' Pedro Neto (Wolves) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' Wolves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Fulham will kick the game off.
Tony Harrington is introduced as the referee for today's match.
